title: French Plantain Empanadas
description: A French twist on the traditional Venezuelan empanada, filled with caramelized plantain.
instructions: 1. Peel the plantains and slice into 1-inch rounds.
2. In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable shortening over medium heat.
3. Add the plantain slices and cook, stirring occasionally, until caramelized and golden brown.
4. In a separate bowl, combine flour, salt, and granulated sugar (if using).
5. Gradually add the shortening to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
6. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
7. Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten into a disk.
8. Place a few slices of caramelized plantain in the center of each disk.
9. Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal.
10. Brush tops with a little water and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes.
